commit.message: test(dcp): harden readonly facade isolation and denylist

invariants: All untrusted retrieved content is marked untrusted.
PR proof is current to head SHA.
OUT OF SCOPE: No new user-facing tools unless required to expose health/readiness.
OUT OF SCOPE: No generic search/fetch unless explicitly approved by supervisor.
OUT OF SCOPE: No write tools.
OUT OF SCOPE: No tunnel secret handling changes.
OUT OF SCOPE: No backend service code changes.
STOP IF: Any test requires weakening a denylist.
STOP IF: Any write path is discovered.
STOP IF: A stale-proof condition cannot be detected.
STOP IF: Embedded auditor returns FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
FORBIDDEN FILE: src/** outside services/dcp-readonly-facade if service is not under src

pr.body:
Harden the full facade with cross-project isolation tests, injection/redaction tests, stale-proof checks, denylist regression tests, no-write evidence, embedded audit, and PR readiness artifacts.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links
pr.title: Harden DCP readonly facade for cross-project isolation and PR readiness

requirements: Add property/fixture tests for multi-project isolation.
Run full facade test suite and compile.
steps.task: Implement per objective: Harden the full facade with cross-project isolation tests, injection/redaction tests, stale-proof checks, denylist regression tests, no-write evidence, embedded audit, and PR readiness artifacts. In-scope work: Add/expand hardening tests. Add property/fixture tests for multi-project isolation. Add prompt-injection wrapping tests. Add redaction regression tests. Add no-write/static hazard checks. Add PR readiness proof docs. Run full facade test suite and compile. Produce final proof bundle.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff.
validation: No forbidden mutating route is callable.
Stale proof and dirty state warnings tested.
Embedded audit PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks.
Proof is current to final head SHA.

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0008/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDIT.md) and run the embedded audit.
validation: Proof bundle present with command outputs and exit codes.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
